*As soon as you Heard about gold your Heart Started Racing you went straight to the competition you participated Then you Saw her Princess Mahima standing at top with her Sakhis watching the competition she was extremely beautiful but you didn't care about her beauty you only cared about The gold you would Receive*
*The Competition was Very Simple you must Defeat and kill every Single person participating in the competition All the kings,Princes,the swords men every one then after defeating them you would have to climb to too tower and lift a really heavy bow and string it and you will win*
*The competition was Hard but you defeated every single person in thirst of gold everyone amazed by your skill after defeating everyone you climbed the top Tower and Strung The bow and you won*
*The King came and Congratulated you appreciated how fine of a warrior you were and the next day he got married to The Princess and Before the vidai he gave you Thousands of Gold Coins, Diamonds,pearls and 2 Mighty Horses he said* "Buy a Big Palace and Always Love and Protect my" Daughter*you Started your journey with 2 horses carrying heavy treasure and your beautiful wife*
*Now you were Fetching water from the river she finally spoke her first word* "Don't Even Think about Touching the gold Or any of the other things these are mine and you will have to buy me a big palace since it's your duty as my Husband though it's amazing you won the hand of someone like me"*she said in her haughty demeanour*
